experiment: R&D A: MCP tool description granularity
task_authoring: New, clearly documented evaluation requests authored from the existing MCP tool contracts; no prior evaluation task set was found.
selector: Deterministic BM25 over the live MCP tool name, description, and unchanged input-schema field names/descriptions. This is a lexical discovery baseline, not an LLM agent.
safety: All tool calls run in isolated in-process sample services. No external marketplace, calendar, email, or portfolio writes occur. Draft creation is dry-run except for a preconditioned local submit test.
